intro.body: we create a warm, welcoming space for our guests. We gather here for the tea — its taste, its aroma and the quiet it calls for. To make every tea session a pleasure for everyone, we have a few house rules.

items.arrival: Last admission for a “Pin Cha” tea session is **40 minutes before closing**; for boiled tea, **90 minutes before closing**. Every tea session ends at closing time.
items.walkIn: If you arrive without a booking, you may have to wait **up to 20 minutes** for a tea master.
items.duration: **Each tea session lasts up to an hour and a half.** To stay longer, please choose a tea for a new session.
items.takeaway: The “Tea to Go” service **does not include a seat at a tea table**.
items.pets: Pets are welcome in the shop, but **please join tea sessions without them**. Guide dogs are the only exception.
items.ownTea: **We brew only teas chosen from our own selection.** We do not brew tea you bring with you, even if you bought it in our shop.
items.oneTea: **We brew one tea per group**, using a single set of the club’s own teaware.
items.boiling: **Boiled tea is prepared only by a tea master.** Please do not boil tea yourself.
items.damage: If you accidentally or deliberately damage anything belonging to the club, the management **may ask you to cover the cost**.

forbidden.title: not allowed in the tea club

items.smoking: Smoking cigarettes, vapes or any electronic smoking devices
items.alcohol: Drinking alcohol, using drugs or being intoxicated
items.food: Eating any food, including snacks and sweets, or drinking anything you brought with you. Exception: when your health requires it

items.silent: Switch your phone to silent mode
items.headphones: Play music and videos through headphones only
items.calls: Take phone calls in the entrance area or the shop; do not hold video conferences or online classes
items.photo: Take photos without flash and do not photograph other guests without their permission

respect.title: Out of respect for one another, please:

items.privacy: Do not join other guests’ conversations uninvited or start loud debates
items.perfume: Avoid wearing strong perfume — it overpowers the aroma of the tea
items.intimacy: Leave displays of passion and romantic intimacy outside the club

items.outerwear: Take off your shoes and outerwear
items.valuables: Do not leave valuables in the cloakroom
items.shoeCovers: Wear shoe covers over your socks, not over your shoes
items.slippers: Take off your slippers before stepping onto the raised platform
